title: Upload your logo, UI, and text requirements as references in Topview Motion…
content:
Upload your logo, UI, and text requirements as references in Topview Motion Studio (Seedance 2.5) to generate a polished 15–30 second motion video in minutes without using timelines or keyframes.  
Describe your idea in the prompt, pick a style, and generate the motion video using Seedance 2.5 in Topview Motion Studio.
